sinopsis.es: Yajaira, una joven indígena, vive con su hija María en un violento barrio de Bogotá. Perseguida por los sueños de la selva que fue su hogar, anhela regresar a la comunidad de la que huyó. Tras la muerte de su sobrino, decide irse para proteger a su hija. Jhon, un joven pandillero del centro, se une a ellas en su arriesgado viaje hacia el remoto río Andágueda. Solo la selva decidirá su destino.
sinopsis.en: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.
